recommendation: Facilitate access to social services and address barriers to asthma care
implementation_steps: Assist families in accessing Medicaid-funded programs and other social services
Address barriers to asthma care, such as financial constraints and lack of transportation
Advocate for housing improvements and environmental control measures
Collaborate with CHWs and care coordinators to address broader social determinants of health
Address food insecurity and employment challenges that may indirectly impact asthma outcomes
evidence_summary: Social worker interventions addressing social determinants of health and facilitating access to services have been shown to improve asthma outcomes, particularly in underserved populations facing multiple socioeconomic barriers to care.
citation: Ensuring Equitable Access to Guideline-Based Asthma Care Across the Lifespan: Tips and Future Directions to the Successful Implementation of the New NAEPP 2020 Guidelines. (2023)
